name: Scholar Quill
conversations: Ah, a reader? No? A listener, then. Even better. Listeners don't dog-ear the pages.
I'm writing a complete history of the islands. I'm on chapter one. I have been on chapter one for eleven years. It's a very thorough chapter.
The oldest book in this room mentions 'the Promise of Root and Sky'. The rest of the page is a coffee stain.
I like to imagine it said something profound. Statistically, it was probably a recipe. Most very old pages are recipes.
Seedhaven claims they planted the Great Tree. Rootholm claims they watered it. Leafwind claims they 'believed in it'.
Barkton claims nothing, but they wrote a forty-page reply to all three. I've read it twice. For fun.
Hear the fire crackle? The old books say the Great Tree once hummed like that, warm and low, and every island could hear it.
It's been very quiet out there lately. Quiet isn't always bad, of course. Just... noticeable.
